decision_rationale: SEAL is presented as a parameter-efficient finetuning method that can be applied to existing pathology foundation models, not as a new primary foundation model. The full text also describes a VAE gene model with a decoder, so generative machinery is present, but the contribution is a wrapper/finetuning framework.
evidence_snippet: "parameter-efficient vision-omics finetuning method"; "we implement a variational autoencoder (VAE) as our gene model"; "applied to widely used pathology foundation models"; "aligns image and ST embeddings"; "five popular FMs"; "decoder"; "gene reconstruction task"; "drop-in replacement for pathology foundation models". Other fields not assessed for this reviewer.
